Lena (CS): Quick note \u2014 StudioX accepted preview seats. Kickoff Wed 9:30 AM PT. Need 10-15m SE demo + a one-page success plan. Who can cover the demo?
Marco (SE): I can do 9:30. Will demo SDK quickstart and live stream example. Need a demo token and sample prompts.
Priya (AE): Client wants clear milestones to avoid renewal risk. Recommend a 10-day playbook: day 0 install, day 2 first calls, day 7 adoption check. Ill add renewal flag if day 7 < 20 calls/day.
Lena (CS): Perfect. @OnboardBot please create project `preview-studiox` viewer token and add client to the Notion playbook.
OnboardBot: Request received \u2014 creating token `preview_studiox_9a` (ephemeral). Reminder: rotate after demo.
Marco (SE): Demo checklist: curl snippet, 2 sample prompts (summarize & classify), latency dashboard link. Ill record and drop clips in docs after.
Lena (CS): Ill draft the 10-day one-pager and post to Notion by EOD. Post-demo micro-survey (3 Qs) will be sent.
Priya (AE): Ill schedule recurring check-ins and invite Legal for a week-2 term review.
Lena (CS): Thanks team \u2014 final runbook 30m before call.
